Cream-colored hood with a brand sticker reading 'EQUATOR' visible in photos 1 and 2, with a small '2' beneath it suggesting a model designation.
Clear plastic front panel on the hood, some scuff marks and a faint logo worn at the top.
Metal stand below shows surface wear/rust spots near the base in photo 0 and 2.
A power cord hangs down from the unit, coiled loosely, no plug or socket visible in any shot.
A separate handheld hair dryer and a wig head are visible in the background; these are not clearly part of this listing.
No shot shows the dryer powered on, heating, or the internal heating element/timer.
